title: Erebus: Harpy Node
tagline: An e ink Court terminal for the Harpy at Athens Through Time live role play events.
description: A specialized e ink web application designed for Kindle experimental browsers, used in character by the Harpy during Vampire: The Masquerade live events. It tracks boons, status, territory domains, and Court gossip in high contrast black and white with touch friendly targets and an ES5 legacy bundle.
highlights: High contrast black and white theme optimized for e ink Kindle displays
Real time boon registry synchronised with the live Court ledger
Status and Camarilla reputation directory with title management
Legacy ES5 and polyfill build targeting older browser engines
